records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Group
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Ridge Group* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 2 (2026-06-05) shows some initial momentum, but no key milestone, no invite sent, zero tickets, and no reply to either outreach (email:16cf2ee9, email:07b578fa) suggests a quiet single-user Starter account; 8 days left leaves moderate room for self-serve activation.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

You've got your first project set up already — nice start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks to that project is usually the step that makes it click.

If it's helpful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's unclear.

Best,
Nadia
